a classroom environment could be considered as healthy if the number of students/faculty is limited to 30 in an average classroom of size 10m x 10m x3m.
the air contamination in a class of students could be detected using low cost sensors and could be used to improve the performance of students.
the concentration level of air contaminants in a classroom is directly related to the number of students present in that classroom.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a class of 20 students could be considered as the maximum limit for a classroom.
, the concentration level of the CO2 increases with the number of occupants and also with the time duration.
, the air quality in a class can be monitored using low cost sensors which in turn can help to improve performance of students.

, we have developed a low cost air quality monitoring system that can help to detect the duration in which the environment can be considered safe for a given number students in a classroom.
, the concentration level of the CO2 in a classroom environment can increase up to 1000 ppm from its standard value of 450 ppm in a duration of two hours.
, the classroom environment could be monitored and made comfortable for a given number students.
